subject: Status: ingestion done, rater throughput risk
body:
Hi both,

Status: the release data is fully ingested — all 11 collection workflows, with MQM annotations preserved down to error spans. Early analysis confirms the paper's direction: post-edited translations carry materially fewer major MQM errors than from-scratch professional translation at roughly 60% of the cost, and the LLM-post-edited workflow is the best quality-per-dollar of the machine-assisted variants.

Distillation recipe v0 is training as of Tuesday — student initialized from our standard MT checkpoint, teacher signals from the post-editing workflow outputs. First eval numbers next week.

The risk is rater throughput: privacy review for the rater queues took the full 3-week SLA, so annotation capacity came online 5/26, not 5/5. That compresses the costed-quality-report timeline. Options: cut two low-priority workflows from the report, or slip a week.

Gustavo
